name: aws-serverless-telegram-bot-typescript
description: A simple serverless Telegram bot built with TypeScript, grammY, AWS Lambda, API Gateway (HTTP API) and SAM

scripts.build: node -e "fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && esbuild src/handler.ts --bundle --minify --sourcemap --platform=node --target=node26 --format=esm --outfile=dist/handler.mjs "--banner:js=import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
